croptopia:candied_kumquats: Seven kumquats, vanilla and honey in a bare grid craft with no cooking tool skips candying in syrup
croptopia:candied_nuts: Nuts plus sugar in a bare grid craft skips cooking in sugar syrup
croptopia:candy_corn: Candy corn is a sugar confection, not made of corn
croptopia:doughnut: Flour, milk and sugar crafted straight to a doughnut skips dough making and frying
croptopia:grilled_eggplant: Only grilled_eggplant_with_garlic_butter exists in the dataset (different dish)
croptopia:limeade: Limeade is lime juice sweetened and diluted
croptopia:macaron: A food press stands in for grinding almonds, whipping meringue and baking
croptopia:mead: Honey, water and a press give mead with no fermentation
croptopia:pork_jerky: Porkchops and salt in a crafting grid skip the curing/drying that defines jerky
croptopia:rhubarb_crisp: A baked fruit crisp crafted raw with no tool
croptopia:stir_fry: Generic stir fry has no dataset ingredient (only per-vegetable 'X, stir-fry' step outputs) and this craft uses no pan or heat
croptopia:treacle_tart: No treacle tart in the dataset (treacle itself is a separate leaf)
pamhc2foodcore:chickenjerkyitem: Raw chicken plus salt skips the drying/curing that makes jerky
pamhc2foodcore:epicbaconitem: Joke item: cooked pork baked with seven game dyes
pamhc2foodcore:fishjerkyitem: Recipe is cut fish plus salt in one craft, with no drying
pamhc2foodcore:gummycreepersitem: Recipe is sugar plus red and green game dyes in a saucepan: no gelatin or setting step, and dyes are not food colouring
pamhc2foodcore:jellybeansitem: Recipe is sugar plus blue and orange game dyes in a saucepan: no gel centre, no sugar shell, dyes are not food colouring
pamhc2foodcore:muttonjerkyitem: Raw meat plus salt on a cutting board skips the cure-and-dry steps the dataset's beef_jerky takes (cure, then dry for hours)
pamhc2foodcore:porkjerkyitem: Raw pork plus salt skips the cure-and-dry process
pamhc2foodcore:rabbitjerkyitem: Raw rabbit plus salt skips the cure-and-dry process
pamhc2foodextended:cheezepuffsitem: Extruded, fried corn snack made by just boiling cornmeal and cheese in a pot
pamhc2foodextended:energydrinkitem: Water, sugar and redstone is not a real process
pamhc2foodextended:mochiitem: Dataset has only specific mochi dishes (daifuku, roasted brown rice mochi), no plain mochi
pamhc2foodextended:pemmicanitem: Real pemmican is dried, ground meat mixed with rendered fat and dried berries (search summaries of Wikipedia and recipe sites)
pamhc2foodextended:ricecakeitem: Raw rice baked straight into a rice cake skips cooking/steaming and pounding or puffing
pamhc2foodextended:sauerbratenitem: Sauerbraten is defined by days of vinegar marination before braising, which a single saucepan craft skips
pamhc2foodextended:silkentofuitem: Soybean heated in a saucepan skips soy milk making and coagulation
